source_basis.boundary: Opportunity definitions, official-criteria summaries, semantic-fit findings, and field descriptions are taken from the gauntlet-agent handoff. Numerical translations into the simulator dimensions are explicitly model assumptions, not official scoring rules unless marked OFFICIAL_WEIGHTED.

student_applied_innovation.label: Student / campus applied innovation
student_applied_innovation.maturity_expectation: A real pilot is differentiating rather than normal; presentation and practical user value matter substantially.

student_ai_industry.label: Student AI / industry application
student_ai_industry.maturity_expectation: Student teams dominate; genuine AI contribution and industry fit are prior semantic requirements, while pilots are uncommon but valuable.

mixed_fintech_ecosystem.label: Mixed fintech ecosystem
mixed_fintech_ecosystem.maturity_expectation: The field mixes campus teams with startups, vendors, institutions, and deployed products; an enterprise pilot is no longer extraordinary.

research_commercialization.label: Research commercialization / entrepreneurship
research_commercialization.maturity_expectation: Differentiated R&D is expected, but commercialization path, institutional carrier, team depth, milestones, and market evidence are normal score-bearing concerns.

elite_financial_security_research.label: Elite financial-security research
elite_financial_security_research.maturity_expectation: Scientific novelty, rigorous evaluation, and mechanism/system depth have a very high floor; customer traction and conventional demo polish are weak signals.

sociotechnical_accountability_research.label: Sociotechnical accountability research
sociotechnical_accountability_research.maturity_expectation: Sociotechnical and institutional grounding is a core requirement that the eight-dimensional numerical model does not fully represent.

academic_ai_research.label: Academic AI research
academic_ai_research.maturity_expectation: Actual AI research contribution is prerequisite; sophistication of non-AI software does not satisfy the category.

oss_research_software.label: Open-source research software
oss_research_software.maturity_expectation: Software quality, documentation, reproducibility, maintenance, and research utility dominate conventional startup traction.

innoserve_adiai_2026.label: InnoServe ADIAI 2026
innoserve_adiai_2026.mapping_note: The official final-stage practicality criterion is translated across problem value, validation, adoption, and viability. This translation is a simulator assumption, not official sub-weighting.
innoserve_adiai_2026.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: Packaging: make the evidence-to-open-policy-to-pilot-block stopping point visually obvious and tie it to a concrete user/practicality story.
innoserve_adiai_2026.gauntlet_agent_note: Commercial weakness is score-material but not dominant; a small real pilot is differentiating rather than baseline.

iii_ai_innovation_2026.label: III AI Innovation Challenge 2026
iii_ai_innovation_2026.semantic_condition: A genuine AI contribution must be score-bearing. Do not add an LLM merely to enter.
iii_ai_innovation_2026.official_criteria: AI technology & innovation 35%; industry/domain fit 25%; commercial feasibility/potential 25%; presentation/team 15%
iii_ai_innovation_2026.mapping_note: The 35% AI criterion is represented by innovation + technical execution only after the semantic AI gate is independently satisfied.
iii_ai_innovation_2026.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: First resolve semantic fit. If genuine AI contribution already exists, package the industry-finance problem and demo; otherwise treat as bad fit rather than modifying Policy Lab for the venue.
iii_ai_innovation_2026.gauntlet_agent_note: Numerical scoring is conditional and must not manufacture AI fit.

fintech_taipei_2026.label: FinTech Taipei Awards 2026
fintech_taipei_2026.official_criteria: Financial-innovation framing emphasizes market feasibility, innovative business model, and solving financial-industry problems; exact official sub-weights were not provided in the gauntlet handoff.
fintech_taipei_2026.mapping_note: All numerical weights are inferred stress weights, not official FinTech Taipei scoring percentages.
fintech_taipei_2026.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: Improve problem-value/demo communication. The expensive high-leverage improvement is real financial validation or a pilot, not another subsystem.
fintech_taipei_2026.gauntlet_agent_note: Mixed-maturity field: institutional pilots and deployed fintech make current validation weakness genuinely score-material.

nstc_research_entrepreneurship.label: NSTC Research Entrepreneurship
nstc_research_entrepreneurship.eligibility_condition: Institutional routing through an eligible research-commercialization platform is required.
nstc_research_entrepreneurship.mapping_note: The call provides criteria but not weights in the gauntlet handoff. Simulator weights are inferred and intentionally leave part of the review unmodeled.
nstc_research_entrepreneurship.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: No cosmetic fix closes the current maturity gap. Market validation, commercialization path, institutional carrier, and team depth are substantive requirements.
nstc_research_entrepreneurship.gauntlet_agent_note: Commercial weakness can block rather than merely hurt.

financial_cryptography_2027.label: Financial Cryptography 2027
financial_cryptography_2027.semantic_condition: The submitted research contribution must be sufficiently novel/deep; the strongest identity is evidence-governed financial-claim admission/constraint enforcement rather than an energy coin.
financial_cryptography_2027.official_criteria: The venue welcomes fundamental and applied financial-security research, systems, deployments, economics/policy intersections, and rigorous financial-transaction contexts; no numerical judging rubric was provided in the gauntlet handoff.
financial_cryptography_2027.mapping_note: Weights are a hostile research-venue approximation, not official FC review weights.
financial_cryptography_2027.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: Sharpen the research contribution and evaluation. Customer traction is not the primary deficit here.
financial_cryptography_2027.gauntlet_agent_note: The vulnerability shifts from lack of customers to whether the scientific contribution is novel and deep enough.

facct_2027.label: ACM FAccT 2027
facct_2027.semantic_condition: A deep sociotechnical/social/institutional contribution is required; technical epistemic discipline alone is insufficient.
facct_2027.official_criteria: The venue includes assurance testing, audits/evaluations, accountability/transparency, governance, system development, responsible-data practices, and risk/harm evaluation, while requiring deep engagement with the social component of sociotechnical systems.
facct_2027.mapping_note: Only 60% is numerically modeled because the current eight dimensions cannot faithfully encode FAccT's central sociotechnical requirements.
facct_2027.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: No cheap packaging fix. A real sociotechnical research contribution would be required; reserve the route rather than distort Policy Lab.
facct_2027.gauntlet_agent_note: Keyword overlap must not be mistaken for venue fit.

taai_2026.label: TAAI 2026
taai_2026.semantic_condition: Actual AI research contribution is required. Sophisticated deterministic software is not enough.
taai_2026.official_criteria: Theme: Agentic AI & Physical AI for Sustainable Innovation. The gauntlet handoff did not provide a numerical rubric.
taai_2026.mapping_note: The numerical model is retained only for a future case where genuine AI fit is independently established; current Policy Lab is not scored.
taai_2026.cheapest_high_leverage_improvement: None consistent with the stop rule. Do not bolt on AI for category fit.
taai_2026.gauntlet_agent_note: Current semantic gate fails, so ranking simulation must stop before weighted scoring.
